title: Noncommutative Rational Sums of Squares in Free Algebras
summary: This paper introduces rational sums of squares for symmetric noncommutative polynomials in free algebras. Under the assumption that the polynomial admits a strictly positive scalar self-adjoint evaluation, our main result gives an operator-theoretic characterization of this class: a polynomial is a rational sum of squares if and only if there exists a degree bound such that, for every self-adjoint operator evaluation satisfying a natural nondegeneracy condition, the compression of the evaluated polynomial to the associated finite-dimensional cyclic subspace is not negative definite.
